hook.say: Five flags, three seconds each. The first one is easy. The last one has a twin. Ready?

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.fact: Japan calls its flag the Hinomaru, meaning the circle of the sun.
questions.sayAnswer: Japan! The Japanese call it the Hee-no-mah-roo, which means the circle of the sun.

questions.fact: The maple leaf flag only dates from 1965. Its leaf has 11 points.
questions.sayAnswer: Canada! The maple leaf flag only dates from 1965, and its leaf has 11 points.

questions.fact: Its 27 stars stand for Brazil's 26 states and the Federal District.
questions.sayAnswer: Brazil! Its 27 stars stand for the 26 states, plus the Federal District.

questions.fact: Nepal's is the only national flag that is not a rectangle.
questions.sayAnswer: Nepal! It is the only national flag in the world that is not a rectangle.

questions.fact: Ivory Coast flies the same colors in reverse: orange, white, green.
questions.sayAnswer: Ireland! Ivory Coast flies the same three colors in reverse order: orange, white, green.
